df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_56/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_56/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city and sum the fare column
result = joined.groupby('city', as_index=False)['fare'].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_56/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
